actions.action: Reserve capacity exclusively for critical history
actions.mechanism: Separate storage budgets prevent ordinary-event pressure from evicting critical events during the bounded outage.
actions.implementation: Partition the existing 20 MB quota; reserve the 2 MB critical allowance plus bounded encoding overhead, and budget metadata separately.
actions.check: Generate maximum ordinary traffic and 2 MB of critical events over 30 minutes; verify every critical sequence survives within quota.
actions.risk: Uncounted indexes, journals, or framing can invalidate capacity calculations.

actions.mechanism: Structured, approved fields prevent prohibited content from entering either storage lane or derived summaries.
actions.implementation: Serialize only approved event codes, sequence numbers, timestamps, and bounded diagnostic enums; reject free text, arbitrary attributes, and content-bearing identifiers.
actions.check: Inject message bodies, credentials, and user content into every input field; inspect buffer files, journals, summaries, and upload payloads.
actions.risk: Apparently harmless diagnostic fields can still contain user-derived values.

actions.action: Record exactly where ordinary detail was removed
actions.mechanism: A bounded reduction ledger distinguishes intentional ordinary-event eviction from unexplained missing records.
actions.implementation: Assign ordinary events their own sequence stream; evict contiguous oldest prefixes and atomically advance a reserved lost-range marker with sequence and time bounds.
actions.check: Force repeated wraparound; verify the recipient identifies every evicted ordinary sequence and never labels retained detail as missing.
actions.risk: Noncontiguous eviction policies require more metadata than one prefix marker.

actions.action: Preserve fixed-size summaries of evicted ordinary events
actions.mechanism: Aggregates retain diagnostic trends without claiming that individual ordinary-event detail survived.
actions.implementation: Maintain counters by approved event code in fixed time buckets; use bounded categories and explicitly mark buckets whose underlying detail was reduced.
actions.check: Replay known event counts under sustained buffer pressure; verify summaries match inputs and partial boundary buckets are labeled.
actions.risk: High-cardinality categories or exact timestamps can defeat fixed-size budgeting.

actions.action: Make retried uploads idempotent at the recipient
actions.mechanism: Stable record identities separate repeated delivery from distinct diagnostic events and genuine sequence gaps.
actions.implementation: Persist a producer epoch; identify records by epoch, stream, and sequence. Enforce recipient uniqueness and flag identical identities with conflicting payloads.
actions.check: Upload batches twice, reordered and overlapping; verify one stored record per identity and explicit detection of deliberately omitted sequences.
actions.risk: Resetting identities after restart can silently merge unrelated records.

actions.action: Reclaim records only after durable acknowledgment
actions.mechanism: Acknowledgment-based deletion prevents interrupted or ambiguous uploads from removing the only surviving critical copy.
actions.implementation: Retain critical records until the collector confirms durable acceptance of their identities; persist acknowledgments before reclaiming segments and retry unacknowledged records unchanged.
actions.check: Disconnect before acceptance, after acceptance, and before acknowledgment persistence; verify critical completeness despite duplicate deliveries.
actions.risk: Post-reconnection backlog growth needs a separate capacity and throughput assumption.

actions.action: Make buffer updates recoverable without quota expansion
actions.mechanism: Atomic committed records keep interrupted writes from corrupting previously accepted critical history or reduction markers.
actions.implementation: Use preallocated segments, checksums, commit markers, and fixed-size checkpoint slots; include all recovery storage within 20 MB and document durability boundaries.
actions.check: Interrupt writes and metadata updates at each boundary; reopen the buffer and verify committed critical records and reduction markers remain consistent.
actions.risk: Power-loss durability depends on filesystem guarantees and flush behavior.

actions.action: Build a sequence-aware outage replay test
actions.mechanism: An independent event manifest makes missing capture, declared reduction, and duplicated delivery separately observable.
actions.implementation: Generate a 30-minute outage trace within the critical allowance; saturate ordinary storage, reconnect, and inject upload retries, reordering, and omissions.
actions.check: Require complete critical identity coverage, declared ranges covering ordinary reductions, duplicate counts matching injections, and alarms for undeclared missing identities.
actions.risk: A test oracle derived from the buffer can reproduce its bugs.
